title: Refactor PCEP object dissection for readability
description:
Remove three lengthy `switch` statements with mostly-identical `case`s
in each one. Instead use a look-up table to choose the object-specific
dissection function.

As part of this, enforce a consistent function signature across
object-specific dissection functions. Add `_U_` annotations to added
arguments which aren't used by a particular function.

Care has been taken to ensure that the dissection of PCEP messages is
identical before and after this change for all PCEP captures I could find
in Wireshark's issue tracker. Tested with attachments from #15834, #13687, #11782, #11213, #11046, #6995, and #5626, by comparing output of `tshark -nVr` before and after these changes.

I'd like to add support for more PCEP objects that have been defined since this dissector's last update. I feel like this change will make it much easier on anyone who wishes to do so.
